Entries: Metabarcode data offer several hypothesized taxa for each ASV in a sample. To convert these data into a single taxon, a consensus taxonomy is required. Here, one taxon_name is given per ASV, a second column indicates if there are alternative likely names.
The consensus taxonomy can be used to evaluate the biodiversity captured in a metabarcode sample. This is used here to create the DataToResampleMetabarcodesR.csv
file which, in turn, is used to generate species accumulation curves for metabarcoding.
